items.detail: ★ 劉瑞農在 **2026/10/22（四）00:18–00:45** 之間於「1151_工程數學（一） ENGINEERING MATHEMATICS (I)（1151_E220610_3）」公佈欄密集發了 5 則貼文：　**①00:18「回應: Updates」** —— The following materials have been posted on Moodle: Handouts & 影片（新教材上架）。　**②00:20「Errata of the handout」** —— There is a typo in the bottom left of the handout（講義左下角有誤）。　**③00:20「回應: Errata of the handout」** —— There is a misleading colors in the …（配色誤導）。　**④00:21「回應: Errata of the handout」** —— There is an erratum in the bottom of …（講義底部勘誤）。　**⑤00:22「回應: Errata of the handout」** —— There is an error in the video of the …（**影片內容有誤**）。　**⑥00:45「MIT 18.03 Differential Equations (Spring 2006)」** —— 推薦 MIT 公開課作為 ODE 補充教材。　★ **為什麼值得花半小時**：老師在半夜連發三則勘誤、其中一則是影片錯誤，代表**這份教材剛剛大改**。工程數學的勘誤不像文字課錯字無害 —— 一個符號或正負號錯掉，整題解法會走到完全不同的答案，而且你會一直以為自己算對。　★ MIT 18.03（Spring 2006）是 Arthur Mattuck 的經典 ODE 課程，講 first-order ODE、linear systems、Laplace transform —— **和上面程序控制 ch1~ch6 的數學基礎高度重疊**，這份補充教材其實一石二鳥。

items.en: U.S. and Israeli Militaries Draft Plans to Resume Strikes on Iran After Midterm Elections
items.zh: **五角大廈與以色列軍方已擬定「期中選舉後重啟對伊朗空襲」的具體計畫** —— 同時伊朗革命衛隊稱擊中波斯灣北部四艘油品轉運船，荷莫茲海峽另有三艘船觸雷，油運風險直接升高。
items.summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guard says it struck four oil-transfer vessels in the northern Persian Gulf, while three other ships hit mines in the Strait of Hormuz. The New York Times reports the Pentagon and Israel's military have drafted specific plans to resume strikes on Iran after the U.S. midterm elections, suggesting the current pause is tactical rather than a de-escalation. The Strait of Hormuz carries roughly a fifth of global oil, so mining incidents and vessel strikes there feed directly into shipping insurance costs and crude prices. Markets have so far treated the escalation as contained, but the reported post-midterm timeline gives a concrete date range for renewed risk.
items.source: Democracy Now! — Headlines for October 22, 2026

items.en: Saudi Arabia Says Four People Are Killed as Houthis Attack Oil Field and King Fahd Airport
items.zh: **沙烏地阿拉伯遭胡塞武裝攻擊油田與法赫德國王國際機場，至少 4 死 8 傷，美國已下令駐沙外交人員撤離。**
items.summary: Saudi officials say a strike on King Fahd International Airport killed at least two people and wounded eight, while a Houthi drone attack on an oil field reportedly killed two more. The United States has ordered its diplomats in Saudi Arabia to evacuate, an unusually strong signal that Washington expects further attacks rather than a one-off strike. Hitting both civil aviation infrastructure and upstream oil facilities in the same window marks an escalation beyond the Houthis' earlier shipping-focused campaign. Combined with the Strait of Hormuz incidents, the region now has two simultaneous threats to energy logistics.
items.source: Democracy Now! — Headlines for October 22, 2026

items.en: Russia Kills More Civilians in Ukraine as U.S. Envoy Witkoff Praises Putin as a "Humanitarian"
items.zh: **俄軍一夜攻擊烏克蘭 12 個州、基輔至少 2 死；美方特使威特科夫稱普丁為「人道主義者」，遭兩黨同聲批評。**
items.summary: Russian drones and missiles struck twelve Ukrainian regions overnight, killing at least two people in Kyiv. Kremlin officials said U.S.-brokered talks will resume next month, which places the diplomatic track and the escalating strike campaign on parallel lines rather than in sequence. U.S. envoy Steve Witkoff's description of Vladimir Putin as a "humanitarian" drew bipartisan criticism in Washington and raised questions about the administration's negotiating posture. For Taiwan-based readers, the pattern worth watching is not the rhetoric but whether negotiations proceeding alongside continued strikes becomes an accepted template.
items.source: Democracy Now! — Headlines for October 22, 2026

items.en: U.N. Says World Has Lost Its Chance to Limit Global Heating to 1.5°C
items.zh: **聯合國報告正式宣告：將升溫控制在工業化前 1.5°C 以內的機會已經失去**，但大幅減排與停止森林砍伐仍能縮短並縮小「超標期」。
items.summary: A new United Nations report concludes the world has missed its chance to hold warming to 1.5 degrees Celsius above preindustrial levels, shifting the framing from prevention to overshoot management. The report argues that deep emissions cuts and an end to deforestation could still shorten the overshoot period and reduce its peak magnitude, which matters because the duration above 1.5 degrees drives how much irreversible damage accumulates. For chemical engineering students the practical consequence is that carbon capture, process electrification and heat-integration work move from optional sustainability projects toward core design constraints.
items.source: Democracy Now! — Headlines for October 22, 2026

items.en: Nigeria Reports Its First Case of Ebola in Over a Decade
items.zh: **奈及利亞確診十多年來首例伊波拉病例**，患者由衣索比亞入境、曾赴剛果民主共和國；當前疫情累計逾 4,600 死、近 1 萬人感染。
items.summary: Nigeria has confirmed an Ebola case in a patient who flew in from Ethiopia after traveling to the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the country's first in more than ten years. The wider outbreak has already killed over 4,600 people and infected nearly 10,000. The significance is the travel chain: a case arriving by air in Africa's most populous country, with Lagos as a major aviation hub, changes the containment problem from a regional one to a potentially international one. Health authorities will now be racing to complete contact tracing across at least three countries.
items.source: Democracy Now! — Headlines for October 22, 2026

items.en: Critical PHP Flaws Leave the Majority of Websites on the Internet Vulnerable
items.zh: **PHP 爆出可讓攻擊者接管伺服器的重大漏洞，影響網路上多數網站** —— 維基百科與 BBC 部分服務一度離線搶修。
items.summary: Critical vulnerabilities have been found in PHP, the language behind most of the world's websites, which could let attackers take over servers and steal data. Parts of Wikipedia and the BBC went offline while programmers rushed to patch the bug. This is the rare class of flaw where the blast radius is defined by language adoption rather than by any single product, so patch coverage will lag for months on unmaintained sites. The market read-through was immediate: cybersecurity names including Zscaler, Okta, Cloudflare and CrowdStrike rose five to seven percent intraday on October 21.
items.source: Democracy Now! — Headlines for October 22, 2026

items.en: Meta Ordered to Pay a $25 Billion Fine Over Facebook Data Misuse
items.zh: **新墨西哥州法官判 Meta 賠 250 億美元**，源自劍橋分析醜聞中誤導用戶資料用途 —— 為該公司史上最大罰款，但仍遠低於州方主張的約 2,200 億美元上限。
items.summary: A New Mexico judge ordered Meta to pay twenty-five billion dollars for misleading users about how their Facebook data was handled, in a case stemming from the Cambridge Analytica scandal. It is the largest fine in the company's history, though far below the roughly two hundred twenty billion dollars the state argued the statute allowed. The gap between the awarded and maximum amounts is the detail to watch, because it sets an informal discount factor other state attorneys general will cite in pending privacy suits. Appeals are near certain given the size of the award.
items.source: Democracy Now! — Headlines for October 22, 2026

items.en: Musk Says SpaceX and Tesla Have Formed Special Committees to Discuss a Potential Merger
items.zh: **馬斯克表示 SpaceX 與特斯拉已各自成立特別委員會，討論可能的合併** —— SpaceX 財報優於預期後股價收漲 7.79%，特斯拉同日漲 3.41%。
items.summary: Elon Musk said SpaceX and Tesla have each formed special committees to discuss a potential merger, the clearest signal yet that the two companies' capital structures could be combined. SpaceX closed October 21 at 159.31 dollars, up 7.79 percent after quarterly results beat estimates, while Tesla closed at 386.47 dollars, up 3.41 percent. Special committees are the standard governance device for related-party transactions, so their formation indicates the discussion has moved past the informal stage. Separately, AT&T fell 6.45 percent as investors weighed competitive pressure from SpaceX's Starlink Mobile plans.
items.source: Yahoo Finance — Stock market today, Wednesday October 21 2026

items.en: World Series Set: Tampa Bay Rays vs. Milwaukee Brewers, Neither Franchise Has Ever Won
items.zh: **世界大賽對戰組合出爐：坦帕灣光芒對密爾瓦基釀酒人** —— 光芒在美聯冠軍賽六戰勝出，釀酒人橫掃國聯冠軍賽；兩隊都從未奪冠，今年必定誕生新王。
items.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays, who won the American League Championship Series in six games, will face the Milwaukee Brewers, who swept the National League Championship Series. Neither franchise has ever won a World Series, so this year guarantees a first-time champion. The contrast in paths is notable: the Rays ground out a six-game series while the Brewers arrive rested from a sweep, which usually favors the swept-series team's pitching rotation alignment. Both are small-market clubs, making this a rare World Series with no large-payroll team involved.
items.source: The Avocado — Sportacados Discussion Thread for October 21-22, 2026

items.en: NBA Season Opens: Pistons Erase a 20-Point Deficit to Beat the Celtics; Knicks Lose on Banner Night
items.zh: **NBA 2026-27 球季開幕：活塞逆轉 20 分落後擊敗塞爾提克**；尼克升起冠軍錦旗之夜卻敗給七六人，雷霆則擊敗馬刺。
items.summary: The 2026-27 NBA season began with the Detroit Pistons erasing a twenty-point deficit to beat the Boston Celtics. The New York Knicks raised their championship banner but lost to the Philadelphia 76ers on the same night, and the Oklahoma City Thunder beat the San Antonio Spurs. A twenty-point comeback in a season opener is unusual because rotations are still unsettled and teams rarely have the defensive cohesion to force that kind of swing. The Knicks' banner-night loss continues a long pattern of defending champions starting slowly.
items.source: The Avocado — Sportacados Discussion Thread for October 21-22, 2026

items.en: WNBA Finals Draw Record Audience as Atlanta Dream Face Golden State Valkyries
items.zh: **WNBA 總冠軍賽收視創紀錄**：亞特蘭大夢想對金州女武神，NBC 與 USA 頻道宣布系列賽開局寫下史上最高觀眾數。
items.summary: NBC and USA Network claimed a record audience for the start of the WNBA Finals, where the Atlanta Dream are facing the Golden State Valkyries. The Valkyries reaching the Finals is the headline story given how recently the franchise entered the league, and the Bay Area market has delivered unusually strong local ratings. Record viewership for a women's basketball championship continues a multi-year trend that has reshaped broadcast rights negotiations. Game three of the series was scheduled for October 21, with coverage across NBC's platforms.
items.source: Front Office Sports — NBC Claims Record Audience for Start of WNBA Finals

items.en: Twin Study Suggests Screen Time's Link to Mental Health May Be Overstated
items.zh: **雙胞胎研究指出：螢幕時間與心理健康的關聯可能被高估** —— 控制家庭與遺傳因素後，效果明顯縮小。
items.summary: A new twin study suggests the association between screen time and poorer mental health may be substantially overstated. By comparing twins raised in the same household, researchers controlled for shared genetics and family environment, two confounders that inflate effect sizes in conventional observational studies. When those factors are held constant, the remaining association between screen use and mental health outcomes shrinks considerably. The finding does not say screens are harmless, but it does imply that families differing in screen habits also differ in many other ways, and those other differences carry much of the explanatory weight.
items.source: MedicalXpress — Twin study suggests screen time's link to mental health may be overstated

items.en: New Review Suggests Not All Screen Time Is Bad for Children
items.zh: **新回顧研究：不是所有螢幕時間都有害** —— 關鍵在內容與使用情境，而非單純計算總時數。
items.summary: A new review argues that screen time should not be treated as a single exposure, because content type and context shape outcomes more than total duration does. Interactive and co-viewed use patterns show different associations than passive solitary consumption, which means hour-counting guidelines may be measuring the wrong variable. The practical implication for students is that a blanket reduction target is less useful than auditing what the hours actually consist of. The review arrives alongside the twin study above, and together they mark a visible shift in how this literature is being framed.
items.source: MedicalXpress — Is all screen time bad for children? Maybe not, new review suggests

items.en: Research Roundup Links Adolescent Study Strain to Measurable Mental Load
items.zh: **研究整理指出青少年「讀書壓力」與可量測的心理負荷相關** —— 對正在排期中考衝刺的你，重點是「休息排程」比「總時數」更能決定成效。
items.summary: A research roundup published this week collects studies linking adolescent academic strain to measurable increases in mental load, alongside the screen-time reassessments. The consistent thread across the papers is that recovery scheduling predicts outcomes better than raw study hours, because sustained high load without breaks degrades the encoding that studying is meant to produce. For a student facing two midterms and a makeup class inside two weeks, the actionable reading is to block fixed recovery windows first and fit study sessions around them, rather than treating rest as the residual after studying.
items.source: DeepDyve Blog — Screen Time and Youth Mental Health: A Research Roundup

items.en: Anthropic Launches Claude Duet, an Always-On Agent in Research Preview, Powered by Claude Opus 5.5
items.zh: **Anthropic 推出 Claude Duet（研究預覽版）** —— 跑在自家雲端電腦上、關掉 App 仍持續工作的常駐代理人，共用記憶／技能／連接器，免額外費用但吃現有方案額度。
items.summary: Anthropic announced Claude Duet on October 21, an always-on agent that works proactively inside connected apps. It is a research preview rolling out by waitlist to Pro and Max subscribers in the United States, and is not yet on Team or Enterprise plans. Duet runs on its own cloud computer so it keeps working after the app closes, shares memories, skills and connectors with regular Claude, and can search past conversations. Features include morning briefs over email and calendar, a Make tab returning editable files, a Tasks tab, Stripe and Shop Pay integrations, and a cloud browser. It is reported to run on Claude Opus 5.5.
items.source: 9to5Mac — Anthropic takes on ChatGPT Dots and Meta Muse with Claude Duet

items.en: Nvidia Standardizes Custom HBM Base-Die Production at TSMC; Samsung Reportedly Agrees to the Terms
items.zh: **Nvidia 要求所有 NVHBM 的 base die 都在台積電生產，三星據報已同意** —— 這把記憶體的價值鏈往台積電方向再搬一塊，對台股 CoWoS／先進封裝供應鏈是結構性利多。
items.summary: Nvidia is standardizing production of the base dies for its custom HBM, known as NVHBM, at TSMC, and Samsung has reportedly agreed to the terms. The base die is the logic layer beneath the stacked DRAM, and moving it to a leading-edge foundry process lets Nvidia specify performance and integration rather than accept each memory vendor's in-house logic. Strategically this shifts value from memory makers toward TSMC and tightens Nvidia's control over its own memory roadmap. DigiTimes flags four strategic concerns for Samsung in accepting the arrangement, chiefly dependence on a competitor's foundry.
items.source: Techzine — Nvidia standardizes HBM production at TSMC

items.en: Google Cloud Adds OpenAI's GPT-Astra and GPT-6 Models to Vertex AI Model Garden
items.zh: **Google Cloud 把 OpenAI 的 GPT-Astra 與 GPT-6 上架到 Model Garden** —— 雲端業者「中立貨架化」的趨勢加速，模型層與雲端層的綁定正在鬆開。
items.summary: Google Cloud has added OpenAI's GPT-Astra and GPT-6 models to its Vertex AI Model Garden, placing a direct competitor's frontier models on Google's own distribution shelf. The move continues a pattern in which hyperscalers compete on infrastructure and tooling rather than on model exclusivity, because enterprise buyers increasingly refuse to accept single-vendor model lock-in. For developers the practical effect is that switching costs between frontier models keep falling, since the surrounding cloud plumbing stays the same. The strategic question is whether model differentiation can survive commoditized distribution.
items.source: Unite.AI — Google Cloud Adds OpenAI's GPT-Astra and GPT-6 Models to Model Garden

items.zh: **Mrs. GREEN APPLE 第 6 張專輯發行日確定，並宣布三年來首次巨蛋／Arena 巡迴。**
items.summary: Mrs. GREEN APPLE has set the release date for their sixth studio album and announced their first arena tour in three years. The gap matters because the band spent the interim period in stadium-scale shows and media work rather than the arena circuit, so this tour returns them to venues where ticket demand historically outstrips supply by a wide margin. For overseas fans the practical note is that arena-scale Japanese tours rarely include international dates, so any Taiwan interest will depend on a separate announcement. Album and tour details were published via otomo.net.
items.source: otomo.net — Release date set for Mrs. GREEN APPLE's 6th album, first arena tour in 3 years also announced

items.summary: The entry works and artists for Music Awards Japan 2026 have been announced, placing Kenshi Yonezu, Ado and Mrs. GREEN APPLE in direct contention. All three appear on the tracked artist list, which makes this the single awards race most relevant to follow this season. Music Awards Japan is the country's newer industry-wide awards body, built to resemble the Grammys in structure rather than the sales-driven legacy formats, so entry lists carry more signal about critical standing than chart position does. Winners are determined by an industry voting panel.

market.highlight: **一句話：台股 10/21 收復 46,800 是「補漲＋族群輪動」，不是台積電帶的 —— 而美股同一晚漲的是太空、資安與晶片，兩邊這次方向一致。**台股 10/21：加權 **46,887.77（+1.28%、+594.84 點）**，成交 **8,331.91 億元**（量能回升），盤中最高 47,254.93、最低 46,454；**台積電只漲 0.62% 到 2,420 元**，真正的主角是**塑膠類股 +6.52%（全場最強）、光電類股 +3.61%**，以及**被動元件、低軌衛星、PCB／載板**三個族群的漲停潮 —— 上市 25 檔漲逾 9%（24 檔漲停）、上櫃 28 檔漲逾 9%（27 檔漲停）。**網通類股逆勢跌 2.15%**，智邦 -7.87% 是權值級的破口。美股 10/21：**那斯達克 26,702.86（+1.05%）、S&P 500 7,757.17（+0.58%）、道瓊 52,856.09（+0.69%）、QQQ +1.05%**，晶片股領漲，**SpaceX 財報優於預期收漲 7.79%** 直接點燃台股低軌衛星族群（昇達科、穩懋盤中漲停、終場皆漲逾 7%）—— 這是今天最乾淨的一條「美股→台股」傳導鏈。
market.note: ★ **今天（10/22）盤前只盯這三件，其他先放掉**：　**①「低軌衛星」這條傳導鏈是真的，但它已經反映了。**SpaceX 10/21 財報優於預期、收漲 7.79% 至 159.31，台股低軌衛星族群同日就把漲停吃完（昇達科、穩懋盤中漲停、終場漲逾 7%），同欣電、金寶、兆赫、仲琦、耀登、燿華同步走揚。**追高風險在於：這是別人財報的外溢，不是台廠自己的訂單確認。**要驗證就看接下來幾週這些公司有沒有實際出貨或接單公告，沒有就只是情緒。　**②真正的結構性消息是 NVHBM base die 全部交給台積電。**Nvidia 要求所有客製 HBM 的 base die 在台積電生產、三星據報已同意 —— 這件事的受益者不是記憶體股，而是**台積電＋先進封裝／CoWoS／載板鏈**。它不會在一天內反映在股價上，但它改變的是未來兩年的價值分配，比任何單日漲停都重要。對照觀察清單：台積電（2330）、日月光投控（3711，10/21 漲 3.64%）、欣興（3037）、台光電（2383）、金像電（2368）都在這條鏈上。　**③被動元件與塑膠的漲停潮要小心「補漲」性質。**塑膠類股 +6.52% 是全場最強，南亞 +8.28% 盤中一度漲停 —— 但塑膠與被動元件這兩個族群今年大多數時間都落後大盤，單日爆量漲停更常是落後補漲與資金輪動，而不是基本面反轉。**判斷方法很簡單：看第二天與第三天能不能守住。**守不住就是一日行情。　★ **觀察清單對照（10/21）**：清單內明確上漲的有 **台積電 2330 +0.62%（2,420）、鴻海 2317 +3.52%（250）、台達電 2308 +1.25%（1,625）、廣達 2382 +2.5%（328.5）、日月光投控 3711 +3.64%、中信金 2891 +4.47%、SPCX +7.79%、TSLA +3.41%、COIN 與 CRCL 各漲逾 4%（聯邦銀行監管機構定案穩定幣規則）**；清單內下跌的有 **聯發科 2454 -0.24%（4,140）、T（AT&T）-6.45%、NFLX -5.31%**。資安族群 **ZS／CRWD／NET** 因 PHP 重大漏洞盤中漲 5–7%，但收盤幅度未確認，故不列入下方 ≥5% 名單。

movers.reason: **工具機／設備股，單日漲停 +9.97%，是當日漲幅榜第一。**不在你的 75 檔觀察清單內。工具機在 AI 伺服器與半導體設備擴產週期中屬於「後段受益」族群 —— 前面的台積電資本支出要先落地，才會傳導到設備與機械加工。**單日漲停可以注意，但不要視為趨勢確立。**

movers.reason: **化工／塗料與接著劑類股，爆量觸及漲停 +9.96%。**不在觀察清單內。**這一檔對你有額外意義：德淵是本土特用化學品（specialty chemicals）廠，產品線涵蓋聚氨酯（PU, polyurethane）、接著劑與塗料** —— 和你化工系的課程內容直接相關，當作產業觀察標的比當作交易標的更有價值。「爆量觸及漲停」通常代表漲停沒有鎖住，隔日續強度要再確認。

movers.name: 華新科
movers.reason: **被動元件族群龍頭之一，漲停 +9.89%。**同族群的信昌電、金山電、光頡、鈞寶、鈺鎧**多檔同步漲停**，國巨與禾伸堂漲約 2%～3%。**整個族群同日漲停是資金輪動的典型訊號，不是個股利多。**被動元件（passive components：MLCC 積層陶瓷電容、晶片電阻）在 AI 伺服器用量持續增加，但這個族群今年大半時間落後大盤 —— **單日族群漲停要先假設是「落後補漲」，看第二、三天能不能守住再說。**

movers.name: 聯茂
movers.reason: **高速 CCL（copper clad laminate 銅箔基板），漲停 +9.88%。**同族群騰輝電子-KY 同步漲停，南亞盤中一度漲停，景碩、欣興、臻鼎-KY 大漲。**這條鏈和你觀察清單高度重疊** —— 清單內的 **台光電（2383）、金像電（2368）、欣興（3037）、華通（2313）** 都在 PCB／CCL／載板這條線上。AI 伺服器要更高層數、更低損耗的板材，CCL 是實質受益者，**這一條的基本面支撐比被動元件強。**但同日**玻纖布族群（富喬、台玻）由紅翻黑**獲利了結 —— 同一條供應鏈的上下游走勢分歧，代表資金在鏈內挑選，不是整鏈看好。

movers.name: 運錩
movers.reason: **不鏽鋼／金屬加工，漲停 +9.84%。**不在觀察清單內。鋼鐵與金屬類股的單日漲停通常和原物料報價或特定訂單消息有關，與 AI 主軸關聯低。**對你的觀察清單沒有參考價值，列出只為完整呈現當日 ≥5% 名單。**

movers.name: 南亞
movers.reason: **塑膠／電子材料，+8.28%，盤中一度漲停 —— 當日最強類股「塑膠 +6.52%」的核心。**不在你的 75 檔清單內，但**南亞同時是 PCB 銅箔基板與玻纖布的上游供應者**，所以它的強勢和上面聯茂那條鏈是同一件事的上游版本。注意：**同族群的富喬、台玻卻由紅翻黑** —— 這種「上游漲、同業跌」的分歧，通常意味著市場在定價南亞自己的特定題材（可能是電子材料而非傳統塑膠），而不是整個塑膠產業好轉。

movers.name: 穩懋
movers.reason: **砷化鎵（GaAs）晶圓代工，低軌衛星族群主角，+7.79%、盤中漲停。****直接受 SpaceX 10/21 財報優於預期（美股收漲 7.79%）激勵** —— 這是本期最清楚的「美股→台股」傳導。穩懋的 GaAs 製程用於衛星與手機的射頻前端（RF front-end），Starlink 直連手機（direct-to-cell）放量對它是實質需求。**但要分清楚：SpaceX 財報好是 SpaceX 的訂單，台廠要等自己的出貨公告才算確認。**巧合的是穩懋與 SPCX 當日漲幅都是 7.79%，純屬數字巧合。

movers.price: 漲逾 7%（10/21 收盤，盤中一度漲停）
movers.reason: **微波／毫米波通訊元件，低軌衛星族群，終場漲逾 7%、盤中一度漲停。**與穩懋同一條 SpaceX 傳導鏈。同步走揚的還有**同欣電、金寶、兆赫、仲琦、耀登、燿華**（這些的具體漲幅報導未明列，故不單獨列項）。**整個族群同日啟動，又是外部財報驅動 —— 追高的風險報酬不划算，等回測月線再看。**（報導寫「漲逾 7%」未給精確值，此處以 7.0% 保守標示）

movers.reason: **網通族群權值股，-7.87% 至 1,815 元 —— 當日最大的權值級破口。**不在你的 75 檔清單內，但**整個網通類股指數同日下跌 2.15%，是唯一明顯逆勢的主要族群**。這一點值得記住：**在 AI 伺服器行情裡，「網通」和「AI 伺服器」並不是同一件事** —— 交換器（switch）與白牌網通設備的競爭格局、毛利壓力與客戶集中度風險都和伺服器代工不同。清單內沒有網通股，這次反而是好事。
